terms.gloss: my godson (goddaughter): the one I lifted from the holy font
evidence: M-O s.v. godfather: (īnfantem) dē sacrō fonte levāre (Tursellinus, 1652)
terms.comment: Latin names the godchild by what the godparent did, after the attested phrase for standing godparent; in fonte baptismālī suscipere is the other (Tursellinus, in Morgan–Owens). Lewis & Short, Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no single word.

sources: Lewis & Short: fons · Lewis & Short: levo
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. godfather.
Traupman and Levi–Bini have no word (searched under godchild, godson, goddaughter, and Italian figlioccio).
